merged: **Domaine des Trois Chênes – Handover Summary** - Vineyard: 18 ha (11 ha Cabernet Franc, 7 ha Chenin Blanc) on clay‑flint soils. - Production: ~62 000 bottles / yr; 2024 output fell to 48 000 after May hail that cut the western plots by a fifth (≈20%). - Certification: Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion started 2023, earliest certification 2026. - Exports: 41 % to Belgium and Japan; Japan limits sulphites to <60 mg/L. - Past issues: 2022 Tank 4 controller drift cost €11 000 (now calibrated pre‑harvest, dual probes installed). 2023 label‑proof error recalled 900 bottles (proofs now require two signatures). - Operating rules (certain): no irrigation on western plots; harvest dates fixed after three consecutive mornings of sugar/acidity readings; any tank >28 °C must be cooled within four hours. - Open items (uncertain): lighter‑weight bottles – importer interest unconfirmed, no cost comparison yet; eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided
